description: This file defines the Subunit class, which extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable and ValueXModifiable interfaces. It provides functionality related to filtering by organizational subunits within a reporting context, including query building and value transformations.

classes.name: Subunit
classes.description: Represents a filter field related to organizational subunits for reporting purposes, providing methods for query filtering and value normalization.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a condition to the query builder to filter employees based on the selected subunit(s).

methods.name: getSubunitIds
methods.description: Parses the 'x' value to extract subunit IDs as an array.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias used in query context, i.e., 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the current 'x' value into an array containing subunit ID and label.

methods.name: xValueModifier
methods.description: Modifies the 'x' value into a comma-separated string of the subunit chain.
